description: This file contains partial class definitions, extension methods, and utility classes related to AWS SQS streaming integration within the Orleans framework. It includes configuration options, stream configurators for both silo and client, and an adapter factory for SQS queues.

classes.name: SqsOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for AWS SQS, including connection string.

classes.name: ClientBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods to add SQS streams to Orleans client builder.

classes.name: SiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods to add SQS streams to Orleans silo builder.

classes.name: ClusterClientSqsStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator for setting up SQS streams on Orleans clients, including partitioning and SQS configuration.

classes.name: SiloSqsStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator for setting up SQS streams on Orleans silos, including cache size, partitioning, and SQS configuration.

classes.name: SQSAdapterFactory
classes.description: Factory class implementing IQueueAdapterFactory for creating and managing SQS queue adapters.

classes.name: SQSStreamProviderUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for managing SQS queues, such as deleting all used queues.

methods.name: AddSqsStreams
methods.description: Extension methods to add SQS streams to Orleans client or silo builders.

methods.name: ConfigurePartitioning
methods.description: Configures the number of partitions for SQS streams.

methods.name: ConfigureSqs
methods.description: Configures SQS options for stream configurators.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an SQSAdapterFactory instance using dependency injection.

methods.name: GetDeliveryFailureHandler
methods.description: Retrieves the failure handler for a specific queue.

methods.name: GetQueueAdapterCache
methods.description: Returns the cache for the queue adapter.

methods.name: DeleteAllUsedQueues
methods.description: Deletes all SQS queues used by a specific provider, cluster, and storage connection.
